name: Puddlehopper
authoring: Blender 4.5.9, original script-authored subdivision and voxel-remeshed model
textures: Original 1024px colour, normal and roughness maps; WebP packaging
optimization: glTF Transform 4.5.1: dedup, prune --keep-leaves true, tangents, webp --quality 90
validation: No glTF errors or warnings. Intentional empty nodes retain clue anchors.
status: Character study. Not rigged or connected to spelling interactions.
face: Continuous projected copper, coral, plum, pollen and jade pigments across the face, eyelids, lip, brow leaves and forehead sepals.
form: Recessed elfin face within a forward-curving orchid cowl with rolled rim, lower lip petals, branching nectar guides, pigment spots and cream edges. Cowl radial fullness and tissue thickness halved.
body: Slender torso, arms, fingers, legs and feet; shared face pigment texture; eight curved, ribbed living skirt leaves with warm edge variegation.
